decisions.evidence: Carroll arXiv:gr-qc/9712019v1, printed pp. 201–202 (PDF page indices 207–208), equations (7.106)–(7.112), explicitly contains the spherical metric, electromagnetic stress, source-free Maxwell equations, RN lapse and electric/magnetic field. Equation (7.113) gives the roots. The proposed replacement (7.151) concerns irreducible mass; the allegation about equation numbers is false. Source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9712019 .

The named standard sphere and product structures were not explicit enough under the mandatory definition rule. Added the exact stereographic atlas, inverse, transition, and product charts from def-gr-schwarzschild-exterior-model (b), with Hausdorff/countable-basis and inclusion checks. This specifies the intended existing structure without changing any RN domain, metric, orientation or potential. Missing exposition is nonfatal, not a false smoothness theorem.

Confirmed the original missing auditable Christoffel/Ricci and quadratic contraction trace. Added a durable sparse rational certificate (all 64 connection and 16 ordered Ricci entries, raised field, 2Q and residual/scalar tables), a standard-library Fraction checker, and a proof linking compressed representatives to the exact algorithm by fraction equality and retained Sigma/Delta/b divisor conditions. Independently replayed 243 exact polynomial equalities; no numerical samples, symmetry substitution for uncomputed Ricci entries, or assumed SymPy correctness. Statement and domains unchanged.
